SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, NVL(f.STATUS, 'NONE') AS RELATION_STATUS, CASE WHEN f.FRIEND_ID IS NULL THEN 'NONE' WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'RECEIVED' END AS DIRECTION FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN USER_FRIENDS f ON ((f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = u.USER_ID) OR (f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND f.REQUESTER_ID = u.USER_ID)) WHERE u.USER_ID != #{userId} AND NVL(u.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE'
AND ( UPPER(NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL), u.EMAIL ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30

SELECT f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, f.STATUS AS RELATION_STATUS, CASE WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'RECEIVED' END AS DIRECTION FROM USER_FRIENDS f JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = CASE WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN f.ADDRESSEE_ID ELSE f.REQUESTER_ID END WHERE f.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId})
AND ( UPPER(NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL), u.EMAIL

SELECT f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, f.STATUS AS RELATION_STATUS, 'RECEIVED' AS DIRECTION FROM USER_FRIENDS f JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = f.REQUESTER_ID WHERE f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND f.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.REQUESTED_AT DESC, f.FRIEND_ID DESC

SELECT f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, f.STATUS AS RELATION_STATUS, 'SENT' AS DIRECTION FROM USER_FRIENDS f JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = f.ADDRESSEE_ID WHERE f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND f.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.REQUESTED_AT DESC, f.FRIEND_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_FRIENDS WHERE ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'RECEIVED' END AS DIRECTION FROM USER_FRIENDS f WHERE (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{targetUserId}) OR (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{targetUserId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY f.UPDATED_AT DESC, f.FRIEND_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_FRIENDS SET STATUS = 'ACCEPTED', RESPONDED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE FRIEND_ID = #{friendId} AND ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE USER_FRIENDS SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', RESPONDED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE FRIEND_ID = #{friendId} AND ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_FRIENDS WHERE FRIEND_ID = #{friendId} AND STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND (REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId})
